message.content:
A classic lasagna typically includes:

| Category | Typical Ingredients |
|----------|---------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | 12–15 sheets (regular or no‑boil) |
| **Meat sauce** | 1 lb ground beef or a mix of beef & pork; 1 small onion (chopped); 2–3 cloves garlic (minced); 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce; 1 can (6 oz) tomato paste; 1 cup beef broth or water; 1 tsp dried oregano; 1 tsp dried basil; salt & pepper to taste |
| **Ricotta mixture** | 1½ cups ricotta cheese; 1 egg; ¼ cup grated Parmesan; pinch of nutmeg; salt & pepper |
| **Mozzarella** | 2–3 cups shredded mozzarella (or sliced) |
| **Parmesan** | ½–¾ cup grated (for topping) |
| **Optional extras** | ½ cup chopped spinach or sautéed mushrooms; 1 tbsp fresh parsley or basil; a splash of red wine in the meat sauce; a dash of red pepper flakes for heat |

**Assembly steps** (brief):
1. Cook noodles until al dente, drain, and lay flat on a sheet of foil or parchment.
2. Prepare meat sauce: brown meat with onion & garlic, add tomatoes, broth, herbs, and simmer.
3. Mix ricotta with egg, Parmesan, nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
4. In a baking dish, spread a thin layer of sauce, then layer noodles, ricotta mixture, mozzarella, and sauce. Repeat until all layers are used, finishing with sauce and mozzarella.
5. Sprinkle extra Parmesan on top.
6. Cover with foil and bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for ~25 min, then remove foil and bake another 15–20 min until bubbly and golden.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
